title: MZ Need help with VisuStella quest journal plugin window

posts.author: Bleuscone
posts.body: Long story short is that my quest journal menu looks like this right now, but I don't want the text to runoff. Is there any way to fix this?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Didn't you already change the window sizes in the plugin settings to make it look like that? Make the window bigger.
If you want to keep the window that size and make some text take more space, that'd need bigger edits because the rpg maker windows have uniform item sizes.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
You can go to that plugin's settings and in there select 'window settings' and there are the JS settings for the different windows. Each gives a value for width (ww), heigth (wh), x coordinate (wx) and y coordinate (wy). But in the base settings many are given the values with some methods, so instead of a plain number it's a method that gets the number.
Anyway you can add +50 at the end of the 'const ww = BLAH BLAH BLAH' line for I think 'command window' and 'list window' and subtract -50 from 'quest label window' and 'log window'.
Then you might also need to change the 'wx' x-coordinate of some windows.
EDIT: add/subtract the values before the semicolon ( ; ) you see at the end of the line
